scripts.check: pnpm run ts:single-version && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:guards && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run gen:api:check && pnpm run db:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:integrity && pnpm run build
scripts.gen:api: pnpm --filter @tugeel/api run openapi:export && pnpm --filter @tugeel/api-client run generate
scripts.docker:build: docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t ghcr.io/ez4puljin/bto-api:local . && docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t ghcr.io/ez4puljin/bto-web:local .
scripts.user:create-admin: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tugeel/api run user:create-admin
scripts.catalog:reindex-search: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tugeel/api run catalog:reindex-search
scripts.partners:reindex-search: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tugeel/api run partners:reindex-search
